= footnote-reuse(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-09-28
:manmanual: Footnote tests
:mansource: acdc

== Name

footnote-reuse - reuse named footnotes

== Description

First footnote:shared[Shared body.]
Identical footnote:shared[Shared body.]
Repeated footnote:shared[Ignored body.]
Reference footnote:shared[].

Unknown footnote:missing[].
Empty footnote:[] and whitespace footnote:[ ].
Later footnote:missing[Later definition.]
Reference footnote:missing[].
Last footnote:[Last body.]
